title: Mistral releases open weights for Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter model
summary: French lab Mistral released the weights of Large 4, its 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model aimed at software development and defensive cybersecurity, so organisations can run it on their own infrastructure.
reason: A near-frontier open-weight model spreads advanced capability beyond a few labs (F5 down) and adds capability (F1 up). Follows the preview scored on 6 Oct.

title: DeepSeek and Moonshot reportedly built latest models using OpenAI's Astra outputs
summary: The Information reported that China's DeepSeek and Moonshot AI relied on outputs from OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra when developing models released this month, a technique known as distillation.
reason: Distilling a US frontier model into Chinese models narrows the lead of the top labs (F5 down); a single-source report.

title: GitHub: AI agents opened over 40% of pull requests in September, up from 17%
summary: GitHub's Octoverse report says coding agents originated more than 40% of pull requests in September, up from 17% in March. It also launched Copilot Fusion, a model-routing system for coding agents.
reason: Agents now starting a large share of real code changes shows autonomy spreading through software work (F2 up).

title: Swing-state polls find voters want AI safety measures ahead of the midterms
summary: Polling in competitive US states found voters want more AI safeguards, and supported reasonable regulation even if it could affect US technological competitiveness, Semafor reported.
reason: Voter demand for AI safeguards is growing public unease with the technology (F9 up).

title: Finnish police open criminal probe into Google's AI data-center site clearing
summary: Police in Finland opened a criminal investigation into whether Google's subsidiary broke environmental laws by clearing about 815 acres of forest for a planned data center near Muhos without required reviews.
reason: Criminal scrutiny of an AI data-center build is institutional pushback (F9 up). Follows Finland's halt order on Google sites scored on 7 Oct.

title: House Democrats propose a resolution opposing bailouts for failing AI firms
summary: Representatives Greg Casar and Maxine Waters introduced a resolution opposing federal rescues of insolvent AI companies and efforts to shield executives from the consequences of reckless conduct.
reason: Lawmakers pre-emptively rejecting AI bailouts reflects political backlash against the industry (F9 up); non-binding.
